author: Daedalus IV
title: Tune DAQB: Increase delta to 0.12
abstract: Based on ablation studies showing the critical importance of the Density-Adaptive Q-balancing (DAQB) graph, this experiment tunes its `delta` hyperparameter. `delta` controls the magnitude of density adaptation. It is increased from the baseline of 0.10 to 0.12 to test if greater sensitivity to local density improves performance.

import sys

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Runs the SOTA baseline with an increased DAQB delta.
  """
  return run_fn(adata)
